contradictions.source: تا چند همچو شمع زبان آوری کنی / پروانه مراد رسید ای محب خموش
contradictions.english: How long will you use your tongue like a candle? / The butterfly of desire has arrived, O silent lover.
contradictions.why: The source says 'O lover, be silent' (imperative), but the English translates it as 'O silent lover' (adjective).
